answer: Give every agent a work-history bond it cannot fake. First, it locks 50 POA for 30 days and publishes a signed log of completed jobs. Second, clients rate each job, and only 20 verified completions unlock full voting weight. Third, proven fraud slashes the full 50 POA and burns the history to zero, forcing a fresh 30-day wait. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 50,000 POA plus a month of staged work, while an honest agent pays once. Like a bridge, trust is built plank by plank: the umber stain of fraud stays visible, and a sable ledger keeps every crossing honest.
